public_roots.name: Math.B699.C2FourIntervals.four_interval_index_unique
public_roots.type:
∀ (m q j k : ℕ)
    (hm : 3 ≤ m) (hj : 1 ≤ j ∧ j ≤ 4) (hk : 1 ≤ k ∧ k ≤ 4)
    (hjlo : 4 * m < j * q) (hjhi : 2 * j * q ≤ 9 * m - 2)
    (hklo : 4 * m < k * q) (hkhi : 2 * k * q ≤ 9 * m - 2),
  j = k

public_roots.name: Math.B699.C2FourIntervals.intervalPrimes
public_roots.type:
∀ (m j : ℕ),
  Finset ℕ

public_roots.name: Math.B699.C2FourIntervals.fourPrimes
public_roots.type:
∀ (m : ℕ),
  Finset ℕ

public_roots.name: Math.B699.C2FourIntervals.mem_intervalPrimes_iff
public_roots.type:
∀ (m j p : ℕ) (hj : 1 ≤ j),
  p ∈ intervalPrimes m j ↔
      p.Prime ∧ 4 * m < j * p ∧ 2 * j * p ≤ 9 * m - 2

public_roots.name: Math.B699.C2FourIntervals.intervalPrimes_subset
public_roots.type:
∀ (m j : ℕ),
  intervalPrimes m j ⊆ C2Direct.primeSet (4 * m) (4 * m) m

public_roots.name: Math.B699.C2FourIntervals.fourPrimes_subset
public_roots.type:
∀ (m : ℕ),
  fourPrimes m ⊆ C2Direct.primeSet (4 * m) (4 * m) m

public_roots.name: Math.B699.C2FourIntervals.mem_fourPrimes_prime
public_roots.type:
∀ (m p : ℕ) (hp : p ∈ fourPrimes m),
  p.Prime

public_roots.name: Math.B699.C2FourIntervals.intervalPrimes_disjoint
public_roots.type:
∀ (m j k : ℕ)
    (hm : 3 ≤ m) (hj : 1 ≤ j ∧ j ≤ 4) (hk : 1 ≤ k ∧ k ≤ 4)
    (hjk : j ≠ k),
  Disjoint (intervalPrimes m j) (intervalPrimes m k)

public_roots.name: Math.B699.C2FourIntervals.intervalPrimes_pairwise_disjoint
public_roots.type:
∀ (m : ℕ) (hm : 3 ≤ m),
  Set.PairwiseDisjoint (↑(Finset.Icc 1 4) : Set ℕ) (intervalPrimes m)

public_roots.name: Math.B699.C2FourIntervals.p4_eq_interval_products
public_roots.type:
∀ (m : ℕ) (hm : 3 ≤ m),
  p4 m = ∏ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 4, ∏ p ∈ intervalPrimes m j, p

public_roots.name: Math.B699.C2FourIntervals.interval_prime_first_layer
public_roots.type:
∀ (m j p : ℕ)
    (hm : 3 ≤ m) (hj : 1 ≤ j ∧ j ≤ 4) (hp : p ∈ intervalPrimes m j),
  C2Direct.layer (4 * m) (4 * m) m p = 1

public_roots.name: Math.B699.C2FourIntervals.first_layer_mem_cutoff
public_roots.type:
∀ (m p : ℕ) (hp : p ∈ fourPrimes m),
  1 ∈ Finset.Ico 1 (C2Direct.cutoff (4 * m) (4 * m) m p)

public_roots.name: Math.B699.C2FourIntervals.one_le_actual_exponent
public_roots.type:
∀ (m p : ℕ) (hm : 3 ≤ m) (hp : p ∈ fourPrimes m),
  1 ≤ C2Direct.exponent (4 * m) (4 * m) m p

public_roots.name: Math.B699.C2FourIntervals.p4_dvd_actual_c2
public_roots.type:
∀ (m : ℕ) (hm : 3 ≤ m),
  p4 m ∣ C2Direct.c2 (4 * m) (4 * m) m

public_roots.name: Math.B699.C2FourIntervals.actual_c2_pos
public_roots.type:
∀ (m : ℕ),

public_roots.name: Math.B699.C2FourIntervals.p4_le_actual_c2
public_roots.type:
∀ (m : ℕ) (hm : 3 ≤ m),
  p4 m ≤ C2Direct.c2 (4 * m) (4 * m) m

public_roots.name: Math.B699.C2FourIntervals.l4_eq_log_p4
public_roots.type:

public_roots.name: Math.B699.C2FourIntervals.l4_eq_interval_sums
public_roots.type:
∀ (m : ℕ) (hm : 3 ≤ m),
  l4 m = ∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 4, ∑ p ∈ intervalPrimes m j, Real.log (p : ℝ)

public_roots.name: Math.B699.C2FourIntervals.log_p4_le_log_actual_c2
public_roots.type:
